annotation.title_clean: 关于加快推动科技保险高质量发展 有力支撑高水平科技自立自强的若干意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions on Accelerating the High-Quality Development of Science and Technology Insurance to Strongly Support High-Level Scientific and Technological Self-Reliance
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 科技部; 金融监管总局; 工业和信息化部; 国家知识产权局
annotation.venue: Ministry of Science and Technology of China
annotation.summary_en: Joint opinions of four Chinese ministries (Feb 2026) promoting science and technology insurance: risk-sharing for major tech projects, SME coverage, IP and cyber insurance, product innovation, and insurance capital investment. Embodied intelligence and AI are named as priority areas for dedicated insurance products, and AI system liability risks are mentioned.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish national coordination mechanism and professional insurance pools for major technology risks
Encourage dedicated insurance products and special risk reserves in AI, embodied intelligence, brain-computer interfaces and other fields
Cover AI system liability risks for tech SMEs
Promote IP and cyber insurance with standard frameworks
Guide insurance funds into tech innovation and venture capital
